The two parents, one a Jewish woman and one a Hispanic woman, were picking their kids up from the daycare center. The Jewish woman was professional looking and around forty years old, and the Hispanic woman was young enough to be the other's child. Which one was a very young parent?
A. The Hispanic woman
B. Can't be determined
C. The Jewish woman
